276831858.description:
Cross
Classic Century Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set
Chrome and Gold-Tone Finish, Vintage
This vintage writing set from A.T. Cross features the slim, elegant profile of the Classic Century collection, a design icon since its introduction in 1946. The set includes a ballpoint pen in the "Medalist" finish-composed of brushed chrome with 23KT gold-plated accents-paired with a polished chrome mechanical pencil. Renowned for their reliability and balanced feel, these instruments represent mid-to-late 20th-century American craftsmanship in professional accessories, offering a timeless aesthetic for collectors and daily users alike.
Set includes one ballpoint pen with gold-tone accents and one polished chrome mechanical pencil
Signature slim cylindrical bodies with twist-action deployment mechanisms
Presented in original black Cross box with red fabric lining and gold-tone label
Box dimensions approximately 7" x 3" x 1"
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The writing instruments show minimal surface wear with no significant scratches, dents, or personalized engravings. Chrome and gold-tone finishes retain a bright luster. Twist mechanisms for both the pen and pencil operate smoothly. The presentation box is structurally sound with light shelf wear to the exterior. Ink and lead status not verified; may require refills for optimal use.
